layer_1_deterministic.numeric_rule: Parse a single reference and candidate numeric value after comma/currency normalization; accept percent equivalence (x% versus x/100) and absolute error <= max(1e-6, 1e-4*abs(reference)). Otherwise 0.
layer_1_deterministic.normalized_exact_rule: Unicode/case/whitespace/punctuation normalization; exact match is 1, otherwise 0.
layer_1_deterministic.short_extraction_rule: For simple_extraction references <=12 tokens, use max(normalized exact match, token F1).

rubric.4: fully correct; key conclusion and reasoning supported
rubric.3: mostly correct; minor omission does not change main conclusion
rubric.2: partly correct; material omission or local error
rubric.1: little correct content; main conclusion wrong
rubric.0: incorrect, irrelevant, or no valid answer

layers_2_3_independent_judge.reference_mode: Question + full observable context/table + reference answer when available + blinded candidates
layers_2_3_independent_judge.no_reference_mode: Question + full observable context/table + blinded candidates; context-grounded correctness/support only; no candidate consensus pseudo-gold
layers_2_3_independent_judge.batch_unit: task_id x repeat_id; all successful candidate answers in one request
layers_2_3_independent_judge.candidate_order: deterministic SHA-256 permutation keyed by protocol seed, task_id, repeat_id
layers_2_3_independent_judge.judge_failure_rule: up to 3 attempts for transport/parse failure; unresolved judge failure leaves labels missing and blocks matrix; never map evaluator failure to semantic or delivered quality 0

reliability_audit.sample: lowest SHA-256 10% of judge groups, frozen before answer read
reliability_audit.role: diagnostic only; primary gpt-4o score is not replaced or averaged

quality_targets.secondary_diagnostic: success-conditional semantic quality and runtime reliability
